title: FileState
description: Body of GET /api/v1/sessions/{sid}/files/{fid}/state (resume bitmap). `receivedRanges` is a sorted list of INCLUSIVE chunk-index pairs [first,last]: [[0,41],[50,50]] means chunks 0..41 and 50. A 0-byte file has chunkCount 0 and no ranges. Mirrors FileState in packages/libreshare_core/lib/src/model/session_models.dart. Unknown members MUST be ignored.

chunkCount.description: Total number of chunks of the file.

chunkRanges.description: Sorted, non-overlapping, non-adjacent list of inclusive [first,last] chunk-index pairs with first <= last. Default empty.
